description.zh:
ECS安全组ID。

> - 1个实例最多可以绑定10个ECS安全组。
> - 您可以通过调用ECS的[DescribeSecurityGroup](~~25556~~)接口查询目标地域的安全组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the ECS security group.

> - You can bind up to 10 ECS security groups to an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.
>
> - You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroup](~~25556~~) operation of ECS to query the security groups in the specified region.

title.zh: 更改MongoDB实例已绑定的ECS安全组

descriptions.zh: > 如果是分片集群实例，绑定的ECS安全组仅对Mongos节点生效。
descriptions.en: > For a sharded cluster instance, the bound ECS security group takes effect only for mongos nodes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-security-group-configuration --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --security-group-id sg-bpxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
